_readme: Error-injection config for the mock. The mock reads ONE row (key='default') from the 'Coastal - Coupa Mock Config (TEST)' Data Table before responding, and branches on failMode. Extends OQ-028's Step-1-only set (user/addr/acct/createreq) with values for Step 1 attach, Step 2, Step 3, and Token Regen. Set the value (updateRows) before firing an error scenario; reset to '' after. Supplier failure is NOT a failMode — it rides on the contractor name (see mock-responses.json suppliers.failWhenDisplayNameContains).
